functions.name: PreFilter
functions.docs:
If there are any connections being replicated and there's a chance Filter() will be called then PreFilter()
will be called exactly once before all calls to Filter().

functions.name: Filter
functions.docs: Filter a batch of objects. There may be multiple calls to this function even for the same connection. Must be overriden.

functions.name: PostFilter
functions.docs: If PreFilter() was called then PostFilter() will be called exactly once after all Filter() calls.
